actionConfiguration.body:
INSERT INTO document_items (
    document_id,
    source_document_item_id,
    line_no,
    product_id,
    description,
    quantity,
    unit_id,
    unit_price,
    discount_amount,
    tax_rate_id,
    tax_amount,
    line_subtotal,
    line_total,
    warehouse_location_id,
    batch_number,
    serial_number,
    expiry_date,
    note
)
VALUES (
    {{ Number(this.params.deliveryNoteId || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.salesOrderItemId || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.lineNo || 1) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.productId || 0) }},
    {{ this.params.description || null }},
    {{ Number(this.params.quantity || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.unitId || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.unitPrice || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.discountAmount || 0) }},
    {{ this.params.taxRateId || null }},
    {{ Number(this.params.taxAmount || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.lineSubtotal || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.lineTotal || 0) }},
    {{ this.params.warehouseLocationId || null }},
    {{ this.params.batchNumber || null }},
    {{ this.params.serialNumber || null }},
    {{ this.params.expiryDate || null }},
    {{ this.params.note || null }}
);
